title: Geller teleported from New York City to Ossining
place_text: New York City to Ossining, New York

tellings.quote: teleported. So, he was walking down the street in New York City 1973, I think.

plain: Uri Geller, an Israeli performer famous for claiming psychic powers such as bending spoons with his mind, was walking down a street in New York City, in 1973 as the researcher Greg Malatzi recalls it, when he was suddenly teleported some thirty miles north to Ossining, New York. Malatzi tells the story as a researcher of Andrija Puharich, a doctor who studied Geller, and points to a Super 8 home film Puharich shot of the screen porch at Ossining. If true, it would be a case of a person being moved instantly from one place to another.
